required_finding_diagnosis.maka_3958: The baseline found the production text-result corruption; the Skill arm missed it and reported a different unsupported P2.
required_finding_diagnosis.tailscale_20673: Both arms found the supported Clear-versus-NewFlow race and both added one unsupported P1.
required_finding_diagnosis.neovim_41328: Both arms traced the production context path but missed the normal :bcd target-buffer regression and incorrectly accepted the patch.

decision: The run supports fewer unsupported P1/P2 findings and more decision-ready reviews. It does not support higher core-finding recall: the Skill arm found one of three required findings and the baseline found two. The one-finding recall difference is too small to treat as a stable negative effect, but it blocks any claim that this Skill has proved better core issue discovery.
public_claim: Claim only improved review discipline and calibration from the combined evidence. Do not claim a stable percentage improvement or increased core bug discovery.
